The Digital Twin must always remain internally consistent.

securityPrinciples: Encrypt data in transit and at rest.

pluginPrinciples: Plugins use published extension points only.

qualityPrinciples: Zero critical security findings before release.

projectRules: Keep architecture simple before making it clever.

vision.statement: ForgeMind transforms software repositories into a continuously evolving Software Digital Twin that enables engineering teams to understand architecture, dependencies, runtime behaviour and software evolution through a unified intelligence platform.
vision.goal: Build the world's most comprehensive Software Intelligence Platform capable of understanding software systems regardless of programming language, framework or infrastructure.

problemStatement.summary: Modern software systems are difficult to understand because architecture, source code, runtime behaviour, infrastructure and documentation exist across disconnected tools.
problems: Large repositories are difficult to understand.
Dependencies are hidden across multiple services.
Runtime behaviour is disconnected from source code.
Developers spend significant time exploring code instead of solving problems.
AI assistants repeatedly need project context before becoming useful.

solution.summary: ForgeMind creates a Software Digital Twin that continuously represents the current state of a software system by combining repository analysis, architecture discovery, runtime intelligence and graph-based software modelling.

productPrinciples: Understand software instead of source code.
Documentation should evolve automatically whenever possible.
Incremental processing is preferred over complete rebuilding.
Architecture should be driven by evidence instead of assumptions.
Every engineering decision should improve maintainability and scalability.
Enterprise quality takes priority over rapid shortcuts.
nonGoals: Not dependent on commercial LLM APIs.

futureVision.objective: ForgeMind becomes the intelligence layer between developers and software systems, allowing engineering teams to understand software through knowledge rather than manual exploration.

reasoningEngine.name: Software Reasoning Engine
reasoningEngine.description: An explainable engineering intelligence engine that answers software questions using graph traversal, deterministic reasoning, runtime evidence and engineering rules.

purpose.mission: Help engineers understand software behaviour by reasoning over evidence rather than generating probable text.

supportedQuestions: What breaks if this API changes?
Which services communicate with this service?
Why is this architecture considered high risk?
rules: Never invent dependencies.
Never infer architecture without evidence.
Every answer must reference at least one evidence source.
Every recommendation must explain why it is recommended.
Answers must be deterministic for identical inputs.
Reasoning must remain language independent.

analysisEngine.name: ForgeMind Repository Analysis Engine
analysisEngine.description: Transforms source code into a Universal Intermediate Representation (UIR) for downstream intelligence services.

qualityRules: Repository analysis must be deterministic.
Every parsed entity must preserve source location.
Language-specific syntax must never reach downstream services.
Only the Universal Intermediate Representation is shared across intelligence services.
Analysis should be resumable after interruption.
Analysis must support repositories containing multiple programming languages.

roadmap.goal: Build a production-ready Software Intelligence Platform.

milestones.objective: Understand repositories independent of programming language.
